items.question: What status and recognition does the Mānavīya receive from all scriptural traditions?
items.inference: The Mānavīya holds a proclaimed and honored status across all scriptural traditions.
uncertainties: The feminine subject implied by samuditā and namaskṛtā is not explicitly named in this verse.
items.plain_english: It is proclaimed as Mānavīya and is saluted by all the scriptural traditions.
